messages:
eli: FYI noticed a recurring pattern in the cost dashboard where confirmed token counts exceed provisional after a model-swap resume. seems tied to quantized model variants changing tokenizer behavior? :confused:
eli: copying relevant logs below, short sequence from a repro run:
eli: ```
2026-03-02T03:12:10Z INFO  router route=canary model=rw-v3-q8 session=xyz resume=false
2026-03-02T03:12:11Z INFO  runtime token_count=26 token_checksum=0x9a3b prefix_hash=a1b2 session=xyz
2026-03-02T03:12:12Z WARN  runtime canary oom -> route fallback to stable
2026-03-02T03:12:13Z INFO  router route=stable model=rw-v3 session=xyz resume=true requested_token_checksum=0x9a3b
2026-03-02T03:12:14Z INFO  runtime token_count=30 token_checksum=0x7c1f prefix_hash=a1b2 session=xyz
2026-03-02T03:12:14Z INFO  ledger provisional +26 session=xyz origin=stream checksum=0x9a3b
2026-03-02T03:12:15Z INFO  ledger confirmed  +30 session=xyz origin=toolcall checksum=0x7c1f
```
eli: provisional +26 then confirmed +30. prefix_hash matched but token_checksum differs. looks like tokenization differs between q8 and non-q model variants (weird but possible due to tokenizer config mismatch).
maya: wow. prefix_hash equality suggests content bytes same but tokenization changed. did router/compile stage perform any canonicalization on tokenizer metadata during resume?
derek: not currently. resume just forwards session bytes and a resume flag; runtime re-tokenizes using the local model's tokenizer. that explains different token_count and checksum.
sara: UX impact: per-route and per-model charts show spikes where confirmed > provisional or diff across models. that confuses billing reconciliation and customers.
jin: immediate mitigation idea: attach canonical tokenization metadata on initial stream credit (token_checksum) and require resume to carry that checksum. ledger can then treat later confirmed charges as the same if prefix_hash matches, irrespective of new token_count, within a short window.
derek: ledger-only rule might be easiest short-term: if prefix_hash matches and checksum_mismatch within 10s, mark confirmed as reconciled to provisional and emit a tokenization-mismatch alert. ledger would store original checksum per session+prefix for TTL.
maya: downside: ledger still needs to know which charge to attribute (route/model). but we can keep attribution but mark delta as tokenization-rewrite instead of double-charge. console can then surface a reconciliation line.
jin: medium-term fix: canonicalize tokenizer metadata across model variants we serve (ensure tokenizer version tag is bundled and identical where upstream is compatible). plus add a resume rpc header X-Canonical-Token-Checksum so runtime can optionally re-tokenize using canonical mapping when possible.
derek: agree. also add an invariant check in router that warns when resume model differs in tokenizer version: RouterTelemetry.Increment("resume_tokenizer_mismatch").
sara: console work: add a new reconciliation metric to the per-session timeline: "tokenization-rewrite" events and an alert rule that flips on >5 such events/min for a customer. we should also add a checkbox in the provisional/confirmed diff UI to collapse tokenization-rewrites from the default delta view.
maya: short-term action items I can implement today:
- ledger: store session+prefix_hash -> checksum TTL=60s and de-dup confirm if prefix present but checksum differs, emit metric tokenization_rewrite_detected
- runtime: include token_checksum in provisional credit log and attach to resume RPC (best-effort)
- router: emit resume_tokenizer_mismatch when model family changes on resume
- dashboard: sara ticket to add collapse flag and event visualization
derek: rollout plan: ship ledger change behind a feature flag to avoid surprise accounting; enable on small canary orgs first.
jin: proposed ledger pseudo-code for de-dupe:```python
# ledger side
key = f"{session}:{prefix_hash}"
orig = redis.get(key)
if orig is None:
    redis.set(key, checksum, ex=60)
    record_provisional(count, checksum)
else:
    if checksum != orig:
        emit_metric("tokenization_rewrite_detected")
        reconcile_confirmed_to_provisional(session, prefix_hash, orig)
```
maya: i'll open PRs: runtime patch + minor router metric + ledger patch behind flag. will add harness that simulates q8 -> fp swap and verifies ledger metric.
sara: i'll own dashboard ticket and add the collapse filter + alert definition.
derek: i'll own rollout orchestration and monitoring thresholds. I'll define canary org list.
ops-bot: Deploy plan created: ledger flag -> canary run (2 hours) -> monitor tokenization_rewrite_detected metric -> evaluate -> stage-wide rollout
eli: thanks all. i'll collect the customer impact notes and notify support if we see spikes. cc @maya @derek for PRs.
